chapter_2_pool.question: Which specific instrument's invention opened up a hidden world filled with tiny living creatures that the human eye cannot see on its own?

During the laboratory preparation of an onion peel slide, which red-coloured stain is applied to give a pinkish colour to the cells?

options: A) To completely dissolve the cell membrane
B) To prevent the cells from drying and improve clarity
C) To impart a permanent bright blue colour
D) To trap additional air bubbles under the coverslip

What is the correct structural hierarchy of organization in the body of a complex multicellular living organism?
options: B) Cell → Tissue → Organ → Organ system → Organism
C) Tissue → Cell → Organ system → Organism
D) Cell → Organ → Organ system → Tissue

C) Red blood cells carrying oxygen
